Entirely invented data (not StatsBomb observations), in the real 360 file format.
Match 9001 has 360 frames for c1-c4, c6, c8; c5 has no frame; match 9002 (c7) has no 360 file.
c1, c3, c4 are top corners; c2 is a bottom corner with the same setup as c1 mirrored;
c3 is a different setup; c6 has a visible area far from the box; c8 has a blank corner
location (side comes from the corner taker in the frame).
